PROCEDURE CODE 
Art 1304
The judgment or decree pronouncing the divorce only has effect with regard to third parties from the date on which it is entered in the marriage certificate or the divorce certificate is drawn up. In the event of the death of one of the spouses, before the marriage certificate is entered or the divorce certificate is drawn up but after the decision granting the divorce has acquired the force of res judicata, the spouses are considered to be divorced, with regard to third parties, subject to the suspensive condition of the entry in the marriage certificate or the drawing up of the divorce certificate.
However, as regards the property of the spouses, the decision takes effect as from the filing of the petition.
As regards the personal effects of divorce between spouses, they occur on the day the decision acquires the force of res judicata
